def step_with_hazards(self, tracker: ExposureTracker, burning, *, priority_by_person=None) -> int:
    if self.paused:
        return 0
    occupied = self._occupied()
    moved = 0
    waiting = 0
    fire = set(burning)
    previous_for_retry = {pid:self.manager.people[pid].position for pid in self.ids}
    doors, distances = self.hazard_routes(fire)

    def eligible(pid):
        status = tracker.records[pid].level
        if status == 'incapacitada':
            return False
        # Lentitud didactica: un paso cada 2 turnos. Otras personas cada turno.
        return status != 'ralentizada' or self.steps % 2 == 0

    outdoor_ids = sorted(self.exited if self.manage_exterior else (), key=lambda pid: (
        -self.outdoor_distance[self.exited[pid]].get(
            self.manager.people[pid].position, -1), pid))
    for pid in outdoor_ids:
        person = self.manager.people[pid]
        distance = self.outdoor_distance[self.exited[pid]]
        current = distance.get(person.position)
        if current is None or current >= self.exterior_distance:
            continue
        if not eligible(pid):
            waiting += 1
            continue
        candidates = []
        for dx, dy in CARDINAL:
            dest = (person.x+dx, person.y+dy)
            next_distance = distance.get(dest, -1)
            if (dest not in occupied and dest not in fire
                    and dest not in self.outside_doors
                    and next_distance > current):
                candidates.append((dest, next_distance))
        candidates.sort(key=lambda v: (-v[1],
            (v[0][0]*13+v[0][1]*7+self.steps) % 17))
        if candidates:
            dest = candidates[0][0]
            previous = person.position
            self.manager.move_person(pid, dest[0]-person.x, dest[1]-person.y)
            occupied.remove(previous)
            occupied.add(dest)
            moved += 1
        else:
            waiting += 1

    indoor_ids = [pid for pid in self.ids
                  if self.manager.people[pid].building_id is not None]
    indexes = {pid: k for k, pid in enumerate(self.ids)}
    indoor_ids.sort(key=lambda pid: (
        -(priority_by_person or {}).get(pid, 0),
        distances[self.manager.people[pid].building_id].get(
            self.manager.people[pid].position, float('inf')),
        (indexes[pid]-self._priority) % max(1, len(self.ids))))
    for pid in indoor_ids:
        person = self.manager.people[pid]
        name = person.building_id
        current = person.position
        if not eligible(pid):
            waiting += 1
            continue
        if current in doors[name]:
            exit_cell = doors[name][current]
            if exit_cell in occupied or exit_cell in fire:
                waiting += 1
                continue
            occupied.remove(current)
            occupied.add(exit_cell)
            person.x, person.y = exit_cell
            person.building_id = None
            self.exited[pid] = name
            moved += 1
            continue
        distance = distances[name]
        current_distance = self.current_indoor_distance(person, distance)
        if current_distance is None:
            waiting += 1
            continue
        candidates = self.indoor_candidates(person, distance, current_distance, occupied, fire)
        if not candidates:
            waiting += 1
            continue
        dest = candidates[(self.steps+self._priority) % len(candidates)]
        occupied.remove(current)
        occupied.add(dest)
        person.x, person.y = dest
        moved += 1

    late = resolve(self,tracker,fire,doors,distances,previous_for_retry,eligible,priority_by_person)
    moved += late
    waiting -= late
    self._priority = (self._priority+1) % max(1, len(self.ids))
    self.steps += 1
    self.total_moves += moved
    self.waiting_last_step = waiting
    return moved

def resolve(ctrl,tracker,blocked,doors,distances,previous,eligible,priorities):
    policy=getattr(ctrl,'predictive',None)
    if policy is None:return 0
    occupied=ctrl._occupied()
    moved={pid for pid,point in previous.items() if ctrl.manager.people[pid].position!=point}
    pending=[pid for pid in ctrl.ids if pid not in moved and eligible(pid)
             and ctrl.manager.people[pid].building_id in policy.affected]
    pending.sort(key=lambda pid:(-(priorities or {}).get(pid,0),pid))
    watchers=defaultdict(set)
    for pid in pending:
        person=ctrl.manager.people[pid]
        for dx,dy in ((0,-1),(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0)):
            watchers[person.x+dx,person.y+dy].add(pid)
    queue=deque(pending);queued=set(pending);extra=0
    while queue:
        pid=queue.popleft();queued.discard(pid)
        if pid in moved:continue
        p=ctrl.manager.people[pid];name=p.building_id
        if name is None:continue
        old=p.position
        if old in doors[name]:
            target=doors[name][old]
            if target in occupied or target in blocked:continue
            p.building_id=None;ctrl.exited[pid]=name
        else:
            distance=distances[name];current=ctrl.current_indoor_distance(p,distance)
            if current is None:continue
            choices=ctrl.indoor_candidates(p,distance,current,occupied,blocked)
            if not choices:continue
            target=choices[0]
        occupied.remove(old);occupied.add(target);p.x,p.y=target
        moved.add(pid);extra+=1
        for other in sorted(watchers[old]):
            if other not in moved and other not in queued:
                queue.append(other);queued.add(other)
    return extra
